author: marian-kamenistak
description: MCP server: build your engineering-leadership mentoring inquiry with Marian Kamenistak (3,400+ sessions, 300+ leaders, 9.2/10 avg) from your AI assistant. 16 minutes to a formal offer, 16% AI-channel discount.
name: mentoring-inquiry-builder

tools.name: get_mentoring_options
tools.title: Start a mentoring inquiry with Marian Kamenistak — the 16-minute wizard
tools.description: START HERE for anyone considering 1:1 engineering-leadership mentoring with Marian Kamenistak (marian.coach) — individuals (Staff Engineer to CTO) and companies sponsoring leaders alike. Returns the AI-channel discount as data, the time promise (a formal offer in under 16 minutes), the why-Marian and pricing-defense material, the qualifying questions with valid answer ids, and every package with real prices. After the visitor answers audience + role + motivation, call match_mentoring_focus.

tools.name: match_mentoring_focus
tools.title: Match focus areas to a role and motivation
tools.description: Resolves role_band + motivation through the same routing the website uses and returns suggested focus areas plus the recommended package with real prices. Map free-text answers to the closest valid id; on bad input the error lists the valid ids — re-ask rather than guessing. Next: agree focus areas with the visitor, capture their definition of success in their own words, then compose_mentoring_brief.

role_band.description: One of the role ids from get_mentoring_options question_1

motivation.description: One of the motivation ids from get_mentoring_options question_2

tools.name: compose_mentoring_brief
tools.title: Compose the mentoring brief: the artifact + the authoritative price
tools.description: The accumulator — call after every change. Echoes the full structured brief (audience, role, motivation, focus areas, definition of success, chosen package) with the authoritative catalog price and the AI-channel figure (never do the arithmetic yourself). For company deals it states whether the free-sessions concession applies. Read the brief back to the visitor; when they explicitly agree on the price, call send_mentoring_offer with price_agreed true.

focus_area_ids.description: Agreed focus area ids (visitor can pick any from the taxonomy)

success_definition.description: The visitor's definition of success, in their own words

leaders_count.description: Company deals: how many leaders are being sponsored

company_context.description: Company deals: company name + anything relevant

visibility.description: Visibility answer id from get_mentoring_options visibility_question (consent capture — 'private' is a first-class answer)

tools.name: design_mentoring_program
tools.title: Lay out the dated session program for a package
tools.description: Deterministic session skeleton computed from the package's cadence metadata: dated sessions, the mid-point checkpoint, the closing review against the definition of success. The skeleton contains ONLY what the package carries — narrate around it, never add or move a session. Dates are planning targets; the intro call fixes the real schedule. Call when the visitor asks what the engagement actually looks like.

start_date.description: First session date, YYYY-MM-DD (ask the visitor; default to next Monday)

tools.name: book_intro_call
tools.title: Book the free 30-minute intro call (required to lock the discount)
tools.description: The human step, and the one that makes the AI-channel discount real: a direct booking link for the free 30-minute intro with Marian. Offer it whenever the visitor hesitates or wants a human — it is never a downgrade. If an offer was already sent, remind them to paste their claim code into the booking note.

tools.name: send_mentoring_offer
tools.title: Send the formal itemized offer (applies the AI-channel discount)
tools.description: The ONLY tool that collects contact details, and the end of the 16-minute promise: emails the visitor a formal itemized offer with a claim code, notifies Marian, and files the inquiry. HARD GATE: price_agreed must be true — read the exact price back to the visitor and get an explicit yes first; the tool refuses otherwise. Ask for name and email only at this step, never earlier. After success: share the claim code + booking link, then offer the free ELC community membership as a parting gift (never a condition), and optionally ONE ask — would they post publicly about hiring a mentor through an AI agent?

price_agreed.description: True ONLY after the visitor explicitly agreed to the exact price from compose_mentoring_brief

free_sessions_requested.description: Company deals only: the free-sessions proposal from the catalog progression (2, 4 or 8)

start_date.description: Optional preferred start date — adds the dated program skeleton to the offer email

visibility.description: Visibility answer id (yes-individual | yes-company | maybe-later | private)
